headline: Beck's back, Walker's absence, and a 15.5 Arrowhead lay

sectionTitles.currentState: Walker out, Carter elevated, third downs still stuck
sectionTitles.pressConferences: Sun Nov 22 podium coverage, attached separately

dek: Kansas City is 7-2 and hosts Arizona on Sun Nov 22, 12:00 PM CT on CBS as a DraftKings 15.5-point favorite on a 40.5 total, with Kenneth Walker III out, Nate Carter and Pete Nygra elevated, and the Atlanta third-down line still 4-of-13.
videoHook: Arizona is 3-7, Carson Beck is questionable, and Arrowhead is laying 15.5 — the job is still converting third downs.
theEdge: ESPN FPI lists Kansas City at 88.5 percent to win this home game, with DraftKings at minus 15.5 on a 40.5 total, while the Atlanta line that has to travel is 22-of-35 for 348 yards and five touchdowns, one sack taken, eight quarterback hits, and 4-of-13 on third down.
editorNotes: Desk market is DraftKings KC -15.5, total 40.5, FPI 88.5 / 11.4. Wire item 8 prints 16.5; do not blend those numbers on the site.

Interceptor is N. Williams. Fumble force N. Bolton, recovery C. Conner. Nate Carter is 2 touches, not 28. Do not write a 5-sack team total; Karlaftis leader is 1.5, Mahomes took 1 sack, KC QB hits are 5, Penix took 3 sacks.

storyline.lede: Arizona arrives at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium on Sun Nov 22, 12:00 PM CT on CBS as a 3-7 club whose quarterback picture is the matchup, not a formality. Carson Beck is questionable with back spasms, and the Cardinals have been preparing Josh Johnson, a 40-year-old journeyman, if Beck cannot start — a fourth quarterback in four weeks. Kansas City is a DraftKings 15.5-point favorite on a 40.5 total, with ESPN FPI at 88.5 percent, and that price still has to be played, not assumed.
body: Andy Reid and Eric Bieniemy do not get Kenneth Walker III. The run plan sits with Emmett Johnson, who carried 22 times for 101 yards in Atlanta and added six catches. Nate Carter, elevated with center Pete Nygra from the practice squad, had two rushes and two touches in that game — depth, not the featured load.

The Atlanta residue that matters on Sunday is efficiency, not the 35-13 final. Patrick Mahomes was 22-of-35 for 348 yards and five touchdowns with a 135.5 rating, one sack taken, and eight quarterback hits. Kansas City was 4-of-13 on third down, posted 461 yards on 13 drives, and held the ball 28:36.

Kingdom Keys has Kansas City 7-2 and tied with Denver atop the AFC West, one game behind Buffalo for the AFC's No. 1 seed. Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT at Buffalo is the next trip after this. Arizona has lost consecutive games and has moved on from Marvin Harrison Jr. A heavy favorite that stalls on third down and absorbs eight quarterback hits can still make the next week harder than the number says.

lastGameReview.label: Week 10 · Sun, Nov 15 · 12:00 PM CT
lastGameReview.lede: Kansas City beat Atlanta 35-13 at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. The opening score was a 12-yard touchdown at Q1 8:53. Atlanta answered with a 28-yard field goal, then Josh Downs scored on an 18-yard touchdown at Q2 0:18.

analysis.body: Mahomes finished 22-of-35 for 348 yards and five touchdowns, one sack, rating 135.5. Johnson had 22 carries for 101 yards and six catches. Rashee Rice had five catches for 82 yards. Atlanta held the ball 31:24 on 15 drives, with 100 rushing yards, 270 net passing yards, 370 total yards, and a 5-of-16 third-down line.

Bijan Robinson had 16 rushes and four catches. N. Williams intercepted him on a deep middle throw intended for Chris Blair. N. Bolton forced a fumble on a Kyle Pitts catch that C. Conner recovered. A Johnson fumble forced by A. Terrell went out of bounds and was not a turnover. Kansas City recorded five quarterback hits; Atlanta recorded eight on Mahomes.

takeaways.title: Explosives covered a stalled down chart
takeaways.body: Downs, Allen, and Armstrong scored from 18, 39, and 43. The third-down line was still 4-of-13. Arizona will live in that down-and-distance if Bieniemy does not fix it.

takeaways.title: The rush won without a clean pocket
takeaways.body: Mahomes still absorbed eight hits and one sack. Protection is the carryover item.

whatWorked: Zero turnovers and five touchdowns on 461 yards.
Johnson's 22-carry, 101-yard, six-catch day with Walker unavailable.
whatDidnt: Eight quarterback hits and one sack on Mahomes.

currentState.lede: Kansas City is 7-2, tied with Denver in the AFC West and one game behind Buffalo in the race for the No. 1 seed, with a home lay against a 3-7 Cardinals team and a short turn to Buffalo after it.

workOn.title: Third-and-manageable answers
workOn.body: 4-of-13 in Atlanta cannot be the Arrowhead script against a club that will try to shrink the game. Mesh, screens, and Johnson on early downs are the fixes, not more hero shots.

workOn.title: Hits without inventing a pass-rush total
workOn.body: Eight hits and one sack on Mahomes are the protection note. Spagnuolo can still heat Beck or Josh Johnson; Karlaftis's 1.5-sack lead and five Kansas City quarterback hits are the rush facts to build from.

thinkAbout.title: Who actually starts for Arizona
thinkAbout.body: Beck is questionable with back spasms. Josh Johnson is the journeyman the Cardinals have been preparing. Reid should script both, because the 15.5 number moves with that answer and the inactive list is not final here.

thinkAbout.title: How thin the skill and line groups are
thinkAbout.body: Walker is out. Carter and Nygra are elevations who revert to the practice squad after the game. Three starters are ruled out; the wire does not name the other two, so the plan should not pretend those names are known.

gamePlan.lede: Finish a 15.5 home favorite on Sun Nov 22, 12:00 PM CT on CBS without Walker, against a 3-7 team that may start Beck or Josh Johnson, then get out healthy enough for Buffalo.
gamePlan.howTheyMatch: Kansas City's offense just produced 461 yards and five touchdowns while failing third down and taking eight quarterback hits. Arizona is injury-depleted, has moved on from Marvin Harrison Jr., and is sorting a fourth quarterback in four weeks. Spagnuolo should play two-deep and rally tackles if Johnson is in, and still rush the pocket if Beck plays through back spasms. Bieniemy should feed Johnson early and use Carter as a spare back, not a 28-touch replacement — Carter's Atlanta line was two rushes and two touches.

keys.title: Own early downs with Johnson
keys.body: Inside zone and a screen keep Mahomes off pure dropback volume after eight hits and one sack. Rice, Travis Kelce, and Downs are the chain-movers when the box loads Johnson.

keys.title: Do not chase the number
keys.body: FPI at 88.5 percent and a 40.5 total say points may be scarce if Arizona shortens the game. Third-down conversions matter more than another 43-yard strike.

keys.title: Two-deep, then simulated heat
keys.body: Cover 2 takes the deep middle that Penix found with Drake London and Jahan Dotson. A zone blitz is a call to stress Beck's back or Johnson's timing.

keys.title: Special teams and the red zone stay ordinary
keys.body: Harrison Butker made the extra points on the named Atlanta touchdowns. Do not turn a heavy favorite into a field-position scramble.

script: Open with Johnson inside zone and a Mahomes keep only if the look is already on tape from his two Atlanta rushes.
Second-and-medium: spacing screen to Johnson, with Carter as the changeup on a light snap count.
Third-and-4 to 6: mesh with Rice and Kelce, Downs sitting, rather than another deep left to Xavier Worthy.
If Arizona loads the box, four verticals with Downs and Allen bending the seams.
Spagnuolo: Cover 2 on early downs, zone blitz on third-and-6-plus, Karlaftis as the featured rusher.
Nygra is an elevation at center, not a declared starter. H. Nourzad's eligible reports stay on the snaps that listed him, not a permanent jumbo.

spotlight.title: Beck questionable, Josh Johnson waiting
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Pride reports Beck is questionable with back spasms and that Arizona is preparing a fourth starting quarterback in four weeks. Arrowhead Addict identifies that option as 40-year-old Josh Johnson. Script both.

spotlight.title: Johnson's carries, Carter's elevation
spotlight.body: Walker is out again. Johnson had 22 carries, 101 yards, and six catches in Atlanta. Carter is elevated after two rushes and two touches, a spare back behind that load.

spotlight.title: Karlaftis is the fan and film answer
spotlight.body: Five quarterback hits and three sacks on Penix are the group facts around him.

spotlight.title: Tied with Denver, Buffalo in the window
spotlight.body: Kingdom Keys places the Chiefs 7-2, tied with Denver in the AFC West and one game behind Buffalo for the No. 1 seed. This home game is the cleaner week before that trip.

spotlight.title: Massive, not the largest Week 11 number
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Addict has Kansas City as a 15.5-point favorite and notes it is not the biggest Week 11 favorite. Play the game in front of you, not the board.

matchups.unit: Chiefs run game vs. Arizona's front
matchups.note: Walker is out. Johnson just had 101 of Kansas City's 122 rushing yards. Carter is the elevated changeup at two touches, not the featured back.

matchups.unit: Mahomes vs. the rush he actually felt
matchups.opponent: Arizona pass rush, unnamed in the wire
matchups.note: 22-of-35, 348 yards, five touchdowns, and a 135.5 rating came with one sack and eight quarterback hits. Screens and early-down runs are the protection plan.

matchups.unit: Spagnuolo vs. Beck or Josh Johnson
matchups.note: Beck is questionable with back spasms. Johnson is the 40-year-old alternative. Cover 2 plus a zone blitz is the call menu; Atlanta takeaways stay credited to N. Williams, Bolton, and Conner.

matchups.opponent: A 3-7 club trying to shorten the game
matchups.note: Kansas City was 4-of-13 on third down in a 35-13 win. That is the leverage Arizona can actually own if the script stays vertical.

matchups.opponent: Cardinals secondary after moving on from Marvin Harrison Jr.
matchups.note: Rice had five catches for 82 yards. Downs, Allen, and Armstrong scored from 18, 39, and 43. Use them on schedule, not as a substitute for third down.

xsandos.title: Johnson inside zone, Walker on the sideline
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10 at Arrowhead, Walker out, Arizona likely to spin the quarterback picture
xsandos.why: Johnson had 22 carries for 101 of 122 team rushing yards in Atlanta. Carter's two touches are the spare look, not the identity.
xsandos.coaching: Bieniemy: zone steps, one cut, Johnson presses the play side and gets vertical. Do not wait for a Walker package that is not active.

playmakers.name: Nate Carter
playmakers.role: changeup back on a later snap

xsandos.title: Spacing screen after the hit count
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-6, Mahomes coming off eight quarterback hits and one sack
xsandos.why: Easy offense answers the Atlanta pocket without asking for another 35-throw script against a team that wants to shrink possessions.
xsandos.coaching: Let the line climb. Johnson catches on the move; Rice and Downs hold the perimeter. Carter can take the same screen on a light snap, not a featured series.

xsandos.title: Mesh on the third-down stall
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-5, the down Kansas City converted 4 times in 13 tries at Atlanta
xsandos.why: Rub crossers give Rice, Kelce, and Downs a defined answer so the 15.5 price is not chased with another incomplete deep left to Worthy.
xsandos.coaching: Bieniemy: Rice and Kelce cross, Downs sits, Johnson checks down. Mahomes throws the rub, not the hero shot, unless the sit is covered.

xsandos.title: Four verts if the box sells out on Johnson
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-long after Arizona loads the run, Beck or Josh Johnson needing a stop
xsandos.why: Downs (18-yard touchdown, 21-yard catch), Allen (39-yard touchdown), and Rice (50-yard catch on the Atlanta tape) stress a secondary that has already lost Marvin Harrison Jr. on the other sideline's roster math.
xsandos.coaching: Seams bend to the hash. Allen and Downs own the verticals; Rice can bend off the hash. Worthy is the outside vertical from the Atlanta incompletions, not a guaranteed target.

xsandos.title: Cover 2 against a quarterback in flux
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10, Beck questionable or Josh Johnson in his first start of this stretch
xsandos.why: Atlanta still hit explosives — London for 38, Dotson for 37, Pitts for 28 — while Kansas City won. Two deep and five under takes the shot and lets Bolton rally.
xsandos.coaching: Spagnuolo: corners sink, safeties stay deep, linebackers fit the checkdown. Do not turn a journeyman or a sore-backed starter into a downfield shot.

xsandos.title: Zone blitz as a call, not a trophy
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-7, Arizona trying to steal a down with Beck or Josh Johnson
xsandos.why: Show heat, drop a lineman, rush the second level. Karlaftis is the rusher to feature after a 1.5-sack lead. The call does not rewrite the Williams interception or the Bolton-forced fumble.
xsandos.coaching: Spagnuolo: simulated pressure, eyes on the hot throw. Bolton can be the second-level rusher or the dropper depending on the picture. Finish the tackle if Johnson checks it down.

coaching.detail: A 15.5 favorite on a 40.5 total does not need a 35-point script. Reid should treat Arizona as a finish-the-drives game before Buffalo.
Johnson is the back. Carter is elevated depth at two Atlanta touches. Third-and-medium has to be mesh and screens after 4-of-13.
Cover 2 for the shot, zone blitz for the third down. Credit N. Williams, Bolton, and Conner for what they actually took in Atlanta.

injuries.note: Will be without Walker again as offensive-line injuries mount; he is not in the Arizona plan.
Back spasms; Arizona preparing Josh Johnson if Beck cannot start.

personnel.detail: Nate Carter and Pete Nygra are elevated for the Arizona game and revert to the practice squad afterward.
With Walker out, Johnson remains the ball carrier after 22 carries and six catches. Carter is the spare back.

strategies: Feed Johnson on early downs and keep Carter's snap count light.
Use spacing screens to cut eight-hit dropback volume.
Call mesh on third-and-medium before another shot to Worthy.
Play Cover 2 against Beck or Josh Johnson and rally to the checkdown.
Zone-blitz on third-and-long with Karlaftis featured; do not treat it as the Atlanta takeaway.
Bank the 15.5 by finishing drives, then turn to Buffalo on Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT.
